## Profile evidence names

The Evidence_Item names the Profile's restrictions promise (profile.toml `evidence`), and whether this evidence store holds them. LK names stand for the Link_Checker's item (`analysis-stack-<binary>`), LN names for `check-profile-lint`, and `proof-kernel-*` names for `proof-kernel-verus` (verification_plan.md section 1).
